info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Retail Orders API allows users to remove specific retail orders that have been marked for cancellation. This endpoint is crucial for maintaining accurate order management and inventory systems by ensuring that canceled orders are promptly archived. Typical consumers include retail operators and inventory managers who need to streamline order handling and prevent rejected orders from affecting stock levels. This API simplifies the process of ensuring that non-active orders are efficiently managed within the retail ecosystem.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel a specific order by providing its identifier. If the order is successfully canceled, a confirmation response will be returned. Please ensure you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an order. It should contain the necessary information to identify the order being canceled.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling an order operation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.title: Order Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the order being canceled.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the order after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for a successful order cancellation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
